info.name: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
info.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI endpoints, allowing remote code execution.

info.name: Exposed Git Config
info.description: The .git/config file is publicly accessible and may reveal repository details.

info.name: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
info.description: User input in the q parameter is reflected without encoding.

info.name: Missing Strict-Transport-Security Header
info.description: The HSTS header is not set.
